name: Calculate a value
description: Computes a value from an expression and writes it to a target field — arithmetic, dates (yearsBetween, addDays, dayOfWeek), strings (concat, upper).

params.name: target
params.description: Field on the current record (or context key) to write the computed value into.

params.name: expression
params.description: Expression — paths and iteration vars are allowed: yearsBetween(now(), $pax.dateOfBirth)
